t: A pocket-sized ESP32-S3 stick with a screen, speaker, microphone, and battery.
steps: Buy the StickS3 from the M5Stack Store for about 21.50 US dollars, or from DigiKey or Mouser in the US.
Charge it with a USB-C cable. Click the power button once to turn it on.
Open the UiFlow2 web editor from M5Stack and connect the stick.
Drag a block that writes "Hello" on the screen and run it.
Try a speaker block to play a sound. Keep the volume under 75 percent on battery to avoid a reboot.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the M5Unified library for text-based coding.
Upload a library example. A green light blinks in download mode.
meta: Open Board. From $21.50. A few stores.
